summary: Full backend+frontend testing of Bank Reconciliation P0 month-filter fix and the 3 new features (prior-year year field, delete confirmation modal, Excel export). All 6 backend pytest tests pass. Playwright UI verified: (1) with period='يناير 2026', the auto-synced 'شيكات لم تقدم للصرف' shows ONLY the January expense check (882919) and not the February one (882920); with 'فبراير 2026' both January and February pending checks appear (rollover works); empty period shows all pending checks. (2) prior-year-check-0-year-input accepts 2024 and is persisted; after save+preview, outstanding-print-row date cell shows 15/03/2024 formatted as day/month/year (Arabic-Indic digits). (3) delete-reconciliation-modal opens with title 'هل أنت متأكد؟'; cancel-delete keeps the memo, confirm-delete deletes it (verified via GET). (4) Both reconciliation-preview-excel-button and export-excel-reconciliation-button-{id} exist and trigger the .xls download without errors (toast 'تم تصدير مذكرة التسوية إلى Excel' appears). Trial balance remains is_balanced=true after cleanup.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py remains ~10.8k lines - splitting into routers/services still recommended (not blocking).

resolvePeriodEndDate handles Arabic month names case-sensitively via includes; if a user types with alternative spelling (e.g. 'يناير 26') without a 4-digit year the filter falls back to 'no filter' (no bug, but might confuse users).
seed_data_creation: During tests: 2 expense records (check payments Jan/Feb 2026) and 1-2 reconciliation memos. All cleaned up at the end (verified via API).
context_for_next_testing_agent: reconciliations-year-filter-select is a native <select> - use page.select_option(value='2026'), not role=option. Date cells in the preview render in Arabic-Indic digits (e.g. '١٥/٠٣/٢٠٢٤') for day/month/year format. Delete modal appears above toast layer; ensure toasts clear before clicking to avoid overlay interception. Bank 'industrial-development' is available on general-union org.
rca of the issue: N/A - month-filter fix + new features work end-to-end. Frontend resolvePeriodEndDate + isWithinPeriod correctly filters auto-synced checks by issued_at <= end of month; ReconciliationCheck.year Optional[int] round-trips through POST/PUT/GET; delete flow uses reconciliationToDelete state + modal; exportReconciliationExcel builds and downloads a .xls blob.
